candidate_unit: one advisory times one canonical GitHub repository repair episode

filters.cve_alias: at least one alias matching ^CVE-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+$; otherwise SOURCE_REJECTED:ADVISORY_CVE_ALIAS_MISSING

malware_predicate.malformed: database_specific present but not an object, or database_specific.malware present but not boolean => SOURCE_REJECTED:ADVISORY_MALFORMED
malware_predicate.true_if: source path is under advisories/malware/ OR database_specific.malware is exactly true

withdrawn_predicate.active_if: withdrawn is absent or JSON null
withdrawn_predicate.malformed: withdrawn is present and is neither JSON null nor a non-empty string => SOURCE_REJECTED:ADVISORY_MALFORMED

multi_package_rules.candidate_expansion: emit one episode per distinct canonical repository numeric ID and exact repair commit SHA, not one episode per package
multi_package_rules.different_repository: preserve a distinct repair episode for every repository; do not collapse across repository IDs
multi_package_rules.package_attachment: attach the sorted unique set of every normalized affected PyPI package name to each advisory repair episode
multi_package_rules.package_normalization: PEP 503: lowercase and collapse each run of hyphen, underscore, or dot to one hyphen
multi_package_rules.same_repository: collapse references only when repository numeric ID and exact repair commit SHA are both equal

normalization.github_repository_identity: positive repository numeric ID from exact repository-detail capture
normalization.repair_reference_case: commit SHA normalized to lowercase; pull-request number parsed as canonical positive decimal
normalization.repository_form_role: repository evidence only; never a repair anchor

pagination.tree_walk: every matching advisory JSON blob at the pinned commit exactly once

required_artifacts: exact GitHub repository response and SHA-256 for each accepted repair repository
exact commit response and parent data or PR-detail response and SHA-256

repair_anchor_precedence: An explicit commit URL supplies exactly that commit SHA; require one captured parent and use that parent as the candidate snapshot.
An explicit PR URL supplies its captured merge_commit_sha; require merged=true and use captured base.sha as the candidate snapshot.
If a PR merge_commit_sha exactly equals an explicit commit repair in the same repository, collapse them into one episode and retain both reference provenances.
Distinct repair SHAs remain distinct episodes even within one repository.
Repository-only and non-GitHub references never infer a repair anchor.
